name: Elastic Email

evidence.marketing: F02: lifecycle automation on Marketing PRO; event-driven campaigns on Email Marketing
evidence.newsletter: F02: Email Marketing supports newsletters and bulk campaigns
evidence.transactional: F02: Email API sends application transactional email through the API or SMTP relay

line: Send newsletters and automated campaigns, or deliver app email through an API or SMTP.

free.text: Free marketing up to 1,000 contacts and 3,000 emails/month

subs.math: 1,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 4,000 emails a month. The free plan allows 3,000, so the Starter plan costs $29 a month.
5,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 20,000 emails a month. Starter includes 75,000 emails and costs $59 a month.
10,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 40,000 emails a month. Starter includes 150,000 emails and costs $89 a month.
50,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 200,000 emails a month. Starter includes 750,000 emails and costs $319 a month.

appmail.math: 3,000 emails a month cost $0 only if they are spread across 30 days at 100 a day, within the free daily limit.
10,000 emails a month fit inside the 50,000-message Starter allowance, which costs $19 a month.
50,000 emails a month use the Starter allowance, which costs $19 a month.
The Starter plan allows only 50,000 emails a month. The current price for 100,000 emails is not confirmed.
